tools.name: supported_coins
tools.description: List the coins and chains you can pay an OpenRouter (Coinbase) invoice with through Rozo. Static list, no network call.

tools.name: quote_invoice
tools.description: Look up a Coinbase payment link (e.g. an OpenRouter top-up) and return the merchant, invoice amount, what the payer pays, the link expiry and whether it is still payable. Creates nothing and moves no funds.

tools.name: create_deposit_order
tools.description: Creates a one-time deposit order; you pay from your own wallet. Returns the deposit address (or Lightning invoice), the exact amount to send, any required memo, the expiry and the rozoPaymentId. This server holds no keys and sends nothing. tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Check a Rozo order by rozoPaymentId: whether the deposit arrived, bridging/payout progress, and whether the Coinbase invoice settled. Read-only.
